fit_reason: The preregistered model is only queried where frozen v1 stops at index65. Across all 65 such allowed development states, exhaustive continuation never improves over frozen v1. The binary target is therefore all zero and gain-weighted positive recall is undefined. StandardScaler+balanced LogisticRegression cannot satisfy the preregistered two-class LOFO/recall procedure. Per protocol, no model, threshold, OOD box, bootstrap gate, or confirmation split is fit or retuned.
structural_explanation: Frozen v1's gap64 threshold 11 was itself chosen as the maximum active-positive gap in the original n12 development set. The retired n14 failed holdout's four beneficial cases also have gap_after64 <=11 (4,11,10,4), so they lie in the v1-continue region. Hence the allowed sources contain no positive labels in the exact region where the new learned layer is permitted to act.
consequence: This is a support/selection failure, not evidence that the tail value is truly zero outside the allowed development pools. Learning incremental continuation at v1-stop states requires a new, outcome-independent development collection that deliberately audits a nonzero fraction of stop-region states while retaining the verified incumbent. Exact audit propensities and costs should be logged. Successful confirmation/disagreement pools remain excluded from fitting.
